verdict.rationale: An agency that runs transactional employer systems such as EAMS quarterly filing could plausibly publish APIs or SDKs, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows any official SDK. The documented channels are web portals (eServices, EAMS behind SecureAccess Washington), paper and PDF forms, and how-to videos, and the probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
